name: PR overview shows the seeded derived intent
description: From PR #482, stay on the default Overview tab and confirm the IntentCard renders the SEEDED pr_intent row (server/src/db/seed.ts): the statement, both scope lists, the computed confidence badge and the source line. Exercises IntentCard + usePrIntent → GET /pulls/:id/intent. Read-only seeded data: the flow never clicks 'Derive intent'/'Refresh', because a live classification needs a model key and e2e runs without one. The card must NOT be labelled stale — the seed writes the PR's own head_sha — which is asserted twice: the stale banner is absent, and the action button still reads 'Refresh' rather than 'Re-derive'. Text is matched in its RENDERED case: the card's headings are uppercased by CSS text-transform, and agent-browser matches innerText. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
